gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent, locally advanced, or metastatic solid tumor cancer excluding primary central nervous system tumors (e.g., glioblastoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: A Phase 1 Dose-escalation and Expansion Study of the PD-1 x ILT4 Bispecific Antibody CDX-585 in Patients With Advanced Malignancies

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrent, locally advanced, or metastatic solid tumor cancer excluding primary central nervous system tumors (e.g., glioblastoma).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic Evaluation: CDX-585 serum concentrations will be measured at specified visits

role_evidence.quote: Patients enrolled in the expansion phase of the study will receive CDX-585 at the dose level chosen during the escalation phase.
CDX-585 is administered by infusion every 2 weeks

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational PD-1 x ILT4 (LILRB2) bispecific antibody

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket in which primary CNS tumours including glioblastoma are explicitly excluded (gbm_excluded). basket set true to reflect the multi-cancer design; GBM is not eligible.
